name: v2.5.21-dev.110
body:
## What's new in v2.5.21-dev.110

- feat(player): show update-available badge next to Settings tab
- docs(player): clarify auto-expand suppression is now the intended behavior
- fix(ci): shellcheck failures in the new update-mode scripts
- fix(ci): update-sequencer test step still ran the pre-split tests/test-update-runner.sh
- feat(ota): isolated two-phase update mode; feat(ui): panel refresh-rate toggle
- fix(lyrion): release pointer capture on A-Z strip, re-fire auto-expand after resume
- feat(website): put email and GitHub Issues side by side as support channels
- Revert "feat(website): highlight email and GitHub Issues as support channels"
- feat(website): highlight email and GitHub Issues as support channels
- feat(telemetry): add AMD/ATI GPU busy% via radeontop
